subject: [PATCH v5 17/22] hpfs: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations for the HPFS filesystem to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated using the DEFINE_IOMAP_ITER_NEXT() macro. This change does not introduce any functional changes and is a conversion to align with the latest kernel APIs. The patch updates the hpfs_iomap_ops structure to point to the newly defined hpfs_iomap_next function.
